text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This staff report recommends a technical amendment to the parking regulations on Dormington Drive between Ellesmere Road and a point 183 metres further north. The intent of the parking amendment is to provide clear sight lines at all times for motorists accessing this neighbourhood along this curved portion of Dormington Drive.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the stopping prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Dormington Drive between a point 28 metres north of Ellesmere Road and a point 183 metres north of Ellesmere Road. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of Dormington Drive, from a point 28 metres north of Ellesmere Road to a point 183 metres north of Ellesmere Road. 3. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Dormington Drive, between a point 174 metres north of Ellesmere Road and a point 49 metres further north.
